confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are bounded from mixed, mostly undated aggregator and venue-level snippets (cost-of-living sites, hotel menus, guide listings) and are rough. Beer, cocktail and wine are the least certain; cocktail and wine lean on the local beer relationship because direct data was thin. Meal anchors are cross-checked against a rough three-course-for-two figure of about EUR 50. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city's tourism profile, not inspected live listings. FX: the 2026-11-18 value was taken from RBA search-result snippets, not a full F11.1 table read, and those snippets had inconsistent page metadata, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against mid-sized Northern and Central European capitals with similar tourist demand and price levels, with the Tallinn Old Town premium reflected in drinks and tourist-facing restaurants.
